def calculate_r_frac(N):
    """Calculates R_frac(N) = sum_{a=1}^{N} sum_{b=1}^{N} {ab / (N+1)}."""
    N_plus_1 = N + 1
    total_sum = 0.0
    for a in range(1, N + 1):

            fractional_part = (a * b / N_plus_1) - math.floor(a * b / N_plus_1)
